topic: 口语专项：深入讨论与四项复测
grammarFocus: 概括、比较、推测、条件与让步；基于个人错误进行复查。
title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 — Speaking Practice, In-Depth Discussion and Four-Skill Retesting
prompt: Some education specialists argue that learners preparing for high-stakes language examinations should be assessed on all four skills — listening, reading, writing and speaking — at regular intervals, rather than being retested only on the skill they find most difficult. Others believe that intensive, repeated practice and in-depth discussion of a single weak skill produces better long-term improvement. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on which approach is more beneficial for learners. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确题目要求你讨论的两种观点（四项技能定期复测 vs. 针对薄弱单项的深入讨论与反复练习），再给出你自己的立场。写作时须覆盖双方观点并说明理由，同时用具体例子支持论证；注意任务回应、连贯衔接、词汇资源与语法多样性的均衡。建议先用几分钟列出双方论据与你的立场，再动笔，确保不少于250词。
